subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial evidence ask, minimal share guide
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@acme-payments.com
Date: Mon, 6 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — starting thread and ask

Jordan —

Thanks for the intro. We're preparing for an upcoming vendor review and we'd like to get your SOC 2 Type II materials for the audit period covering 2024-11-01 through 2025-04-30. In particular, can you provide: 

- A copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if necessary)
- A bridge letter if the report does not cover the exact window above
- A short scope matrix indicating included systems and any exclusions
- Evidence transfer options (SFTP, secure Drive link, or dedicated portal)

We have a compressed timeline — would you be able to confirm what you can share and how soon (we're hoping for materials within 5 business days)? Also, please point us to a short reply template we can use internally if we need to request redactions or a limited-scope share.

Appreciate it,
Liam O'Connor
Vendor Risk Manager
Acme Payments

---

[Note: external request — customer-facing, no attachments included here]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Oct 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — starting thread and ask

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear list. High level: we can share a redacted PDF of our SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter covering the audit period you requested. For evidence, we prefer a secure Drive share but can also use SFTP or a temporary portal link depending on your preference and DLP requirements. 

Quick answers to your bullets: 
- SOC 2 Type II report: yes (we will redact customer-identifying data).
- Bridge letter: yes — we have a standard draft we can tailor to the period 2024-11-01 through 2025-04-30.
- Scope matrix: we'll provide a concise XLSX that maps control families to systems/services included in the assessment.
- Evidence transfer: secure Drive link is simplest; we can also provide an SFTP account for one-time pulls.

Timing: we can deliver the redacted report + bridge letter + scope matrix within 3 business days if you confirm secure Drive is acceptable. If you need a tailored redaction (e.g., remove specific sections), please flag which items and we'll route to legal for the shortest turnaround.

Below I've pasted two short reply snippets you can use internally — one to request the full share and one if you require an expanded evidence review. Feel free to reuse verbatim.

-- Internal-facing confirmation (one-liner) --
"Redwood has confirmed availability of its redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter covering 2024-11-01 to 2025-04-30; materials will be shared via a secure Drive link within 3 business days unless otherwise requested."

-- Expanded evidence request template --
"Can Redwood provide the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), the bridge letter for the audit window, and the scope matrix? Additionally, please provide sample evidence artifacts for authentication (e.g., MFA policy + audit logs summary), change control (change ticket sample), and backup verification (backup policy excerpt). If a portal or SFTP is used, advise on filenames and folder layout."

I'll prepare the files and upload them to the Drive. Marissa, Ben — please see the internal notes for the bridge letter and scope matrix attached drafts. Liam, would you like the Drive folder shared with your security_ops account or an SFTP credential?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial evidence ask, minimal share guide

Jordan / Ben —

Attaching two drafts: a short bridge-letter PDF and the scope matrix XLSX. I've pulled the minimal evidence list we recommend for one-off vendor reviews — the goal is to keep the initial share lean: 

Minimal evidence bundle (recommended):
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter (PDF)
- Scope matrix (XLSX)
- MFA policy excerpt (PDF, 2 pages)
- Change control sample ticket (PDF or HTML export)

Notes on redaction: redact customer names and exact CVE ticket IDs that reveal customer-specific incidents; leave control descriptions intact. For logs, provide summary extracts (counts/timestamps) instead of full PII-bearing logs. 

I'll prepare the Drive folder layout: /Acme-Requests/ACME-2025-SOC2/ with subfolders docs/ and evidence-samples/. I'll also include a short README.txt with context and a contact person.

If Acme requests more evidence after review, we can escalate to Ben for a scoped evidence sprint.

Marissa Cole
Compliance & Trust Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-bridge-letter-draft.pdf, redwood-soc2-scope-matrix.xlsx
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@acme-payments.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Oct 2025 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial evidence ask, minimal share guide

Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks — Drive share is perfect. Please proceed with the redacted report, bridge letter, scope matrix, and the minimal evidence bundle you outlined. We'll review and come back with any follow-ups within 3 business days.

One quick ask on the README: can you include a short statement on retention (how long Redwood retains audit logs) and a contact for urgent access requests? That will speed our internal approval.

If possible, mark files with the audit window in the filenames (e.g., redwood-soc2-2024-11-01_2025-04-30.pdf) — our procurement team prefers explicit date ranges.

Appreciate the speed here.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Vendor Risk Manager, Acme Payments
